title: Jig: overview
description: What the agent cost and how its tool calls went. Days are UTC days, like the record files.

targets.rawQueryText:

FROM turn
WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000

panels.title: Calls that failed
panels.description: Calls whose tool ran and failed, or that never reached it (outcome error).

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT count(*) AS errors
FROM call
WHERE outcome = 'error' AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
targets.queryText:

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(time / 86400 AS INTEGER) * 86400 AS day, round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost
FROM turn
WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Calls and errors per day
panels.description: Each bar is the calls of a day, split by how they ended. An error ran and failed or never ran; blocked means a rule refused it or you declined.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(time / 86400 AS INTEGER) * 86400 AS day,
       sum(outcome = 'ok') AS ok,
       sum(outcome = 'error') AS errors,
       sum(outcome = 'blocked') AS blocked
FROM call
WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
targets.queryText:

       sum(outcome = 'blocked') AS blocked
FROM call
WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Cost per model
panels.description: Cache hit is the share of prompt tokens that were read from the cache.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT model,
       round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost,
       count(*) AS turns,
       sum(input) AS input,
       sum(output) AS output,
       sum(cacheRead) AS "cache read",
       sum(cacheWrite) AS "cache write",
       round(100.0 * sum(cacheRead) / nullif(sum(input) + sum(cacheRead) + sum(cacheWrite), 0), 1) AS "cache hit %"
FROM turn
WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY cost DESC, model
targets.queryText:
SELECT model,

panels.title: Cost per agent role
panels.description: The main agent is main; a child agent has the role it was started with, such as a reviewer.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT agentRole AS role,
       round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost,
       count(*) AS turns,
       count(DISTINCT session) AS sessions
FROM turn
WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
GROUP BY agentRole
ORDER BY cost DESC, role

GROUP BY agentRole
ORDER BY cost DESC, role

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT coalesce(ticket, '(none)') AS ticket,

       count(DISTINCT session) AS sessions,

FROM turn
WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
GROUP BY ticket
ORDER BY cost DESC, ticket

panels.title: Sessions, by cost
panels.description: Click a session to see every call and turn in it.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH events AS (
    SELECT session, agentRole, ticket, time, cost, 0 AS calls, 0 AS errors
    FROM turn
    WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
    UNION ALL
    SELECT session, agentRole, ticket, time, 0.0, 1, outcome = 'error'
    FROM call
    WHERE time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000
)
SELECT session,
       min(agentRole) AS role,
       max(ticket) AS ticket,
       min(time) AS started,
       round(sum(cost), 4) AS cost,
       sum(calls) AS calls,
       sum(errors) AS errors
FROM events
GROUP BY session
ORDER BY sum(cost) DESC, session
LIMIT 100
